name: Dwarves
background:
Dwarves are short humanoids who have developed advanced steam-powered technology and runic magic. They wear heavy armour and rely on powerful ranged weapons to make up for their slow speed. 

The Dwarves dwell in the ruins of their old holds scattered through the mountains of Tyria. During the Havoc Wars, Orc tribes attacked their homes and subjugated their people while the Dwarf armies were campaigning. The Dwarves hoped their allies would rescue them, but help never came. Now they have returned to their holds and barred the doors to outsiders, determined to never allow themselves to be conquered again.
backgroundFull:
The Dwarven tribes were once spread throughout Tyria, but as the plains were settled by humanity and Orcs came to the grasslands, the Dwarves retreated into the mountains. They made their homes in their mountains, creating powerful fortresses surrounded by terrace farms on the heights, and dug mines deep below. For most of their history, Dwarves had to travel overland, often through hostile territory, to visit and trade with other Dwarfholds. They began to experiment with ways to travel safely, until they discovered powered flight, and their helicopter convoys became a common sight between the mountains of Tyria. 

When Havoc arrived in Tyria, the Northern Dwarfholds were soon overrun. The northern Dwarves fought back even after losing their homes, and the southern Dwarves joined with the Great Alliance to protect their homes. With the Dwarven armies on campaign against Havoc, the Orcs attacked and soon conquered the Dwarfholds. The Dwarven armies were forced to return home right before the final confrontation with Havoc in order to save their families, however they were unable to defeat the Orcs who turned their own defences against them. 

The remaining Dwarves had a difficult life under the Orcs. The Orcs drove the Dwarves out of their holds and took whatever they wished from their subjects. The Dwarves held little status, reduced to performing hard labour in the fields and mines, and with their former allies too weakened to help, they lived under cruel Orc rule for generations. 

Then the Great Rift tore through the land, destroying many of the ancient holds. Many Orcs were killed by cave-ins, whilst the rest were forced to abandon the holds, leaving behind much of their armour and weapons. The Dwarves took the opportunity to rise up, using whatever weapons and tools they could find to seize back their destroyed holds. Much of their ancient wealth was lost, either buried, carried away by Orcs, or traded away long ago. Despite this, the Dwarves were determined to rebuild. 

Dwarves soon developed industries and new technologies like coal-powered Constructs and factories. Their once glorious holds laden with gold and gems are now polluted ruins, supported by steel and steam, and they venture out only to take what they need and settle old grudges. No matter what, the Dwarves will not allow their homes to fall again. 

How will you defend your hold?

product.description:
A Dwarf steps forward, addressing the crowd. He is handsome, with a chiseled face, long blond hair, and a styled beard. On his chest, he wears a small crest with a regal insignia. His armour is ornate and extremely well-crafted, even including a fur-trimmed cloak, but you can see faint traces of rust which have been carefully polished over.
Though you cannot hear his words, you have little doubt that this is Gamharl.

specialRules.name: Unwieldy
specialRules.description: Strikes last when charging.

specialRules.name: Precision Frenzy
specialRules.description: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game.

specialRules.name: Infiltrate
specialRules.description: This model counts as having Ambush, and may be deployed fully within 12" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Quick Throw
specialRules.description: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).

specialRules.name: Sturdy
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't started an activation yet this round, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Sturdy
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Sturdy, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Sturdy (instead of only as long as they haven't started an activation yet).

specialRules.name: Unique Hero
specialRules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Spell Resistance.

specialRules.name: Swift Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Swift.

specialRules.name: Precision Charge Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when charging.

specialRules.name: Relentless Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Relentless.

specialRules.name: Rending in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Rending in melee.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Sturdy Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Enhanced Sturdy.

specialRules.name: Entrenched
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Precision Charge
specialRules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when charging.

specialRules.name: Cumbersome
specialRules.description: May only use Hold or Advance actions, but can’t shoot when moving.

specialRules.name: Spawn
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it.

specialRules.name: Speed Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

specialRules.name: Scourge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon counts as having dealt 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Crossing Strike
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

specialRules.name: Spell Accumulator
specialRules.description: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Swift
specialRules.description: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

specialRules.name: Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't started an activation yet this round, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Guarded, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Guarded (instead of only as long as they haven't started an activation yet).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed fully within 6” of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero, but must use the unit’s Defense until all other models have been killed. The Hero’s unit, and units within 6” of friendly Heroes with Tough(9) or higher, may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Rending
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.name: Slow
specialRules.description: Moves -2” when using Advance, and -4” when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.
